title: Engelbrektsloppet Aerobic Base Building - 70min Steady Endurance

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through full range of motion, synchronize breathing with movement. Inhale on extension, exhale on flexion.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg while maintaining a neutral spine. Hold each rep for 1 second. Focus on core stability.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the movement between positions, avoid bouncing. Keep chest upright and core engaged throughout.

items.name: Air Bike - Easy Pace
items.cues: Start at RPE 3-4 to elevate heart rate gradually. Focus on smooth pedaling cadence, aim for 90+ rpm.

items.name: Air Bike - Steady State Endurance
items.cues: Maintain RPE 5-6 (conversational pace). Hold consistent cadence of 85-95 rpm. This is your aerobic base work for 45km race prep. Focus on efficiency and steady breathing. Every 15 minutes, do a quick form check: relaxed shoulders, engaged core, smooth pedal stroke.

items.name: Air Bike - Easy Spin Down
items.cues: Reduce intensity to RPE 3-4. Light pedaling at 80-85 rpm to begin recovery process. Gradually lower heart rate.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold a deep but comfortable stretch. Keep heel planted. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place forearm against wall at shoulder height. Gently rotate body away. Hold steady, breathe naturally.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, controlled movements to decompress spine after endurance work. Promotes parasympathetic response.

rationale: With 20 days until Engelbrektsloppet 45km, this workout builds aerobic base capacity at RPE 5-6, which is the sustainable race intensity for ultra-distance events. A 55-minute steady-state bike session develops your aerobic engine.

Recent training shows consistent endurance work; this session maintains that rhythm while respecting the advanced fitness level. The steady-state approach avoids accumulating additional fatigue from the recent strength sessions on 2026-01-11.
Air Bike is appropriate for gym-based endurance training and allows precise intensity control (RPE 5-6). The 70-minute total duration matches the target with adequate warmup and recovery protocols.
